metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "A C4 model of the insurance claims platform" {
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "A policyholder who reports claims and tracks their progress"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress" "Web Application"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app" "API"
            claimsIntakeService = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims" "Service"
            triageService = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims" "Service"
            assessmentService = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts" "Service"
            payoutService = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements" "Service"
            fraudScreeningService = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims" "Service"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports" "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders" "Service"
            assignmentService = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters" "Service"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims" "Web Application"
            policyVerificationService = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy" "Service"
            reinsuranceAllocationService = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners" "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation" "Batch"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts" "Queue"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records" "Database"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records" "Database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence" "File Store"
        }

        nationalClaimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks progress"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks progress"

        fraudScreeningService -> nationalClaimsDataBureau "consults"
        payoutService -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through"

        webPortal -> claimsIntakeService "reaches"
        webPortal -> assessmentService "reaches"
        webPortal -> payoutService "reaches"
        webPortal -> documentService "reaches"
        webPortal -> notificationService "reaches"

        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntakeService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessmentService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> payoutService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "reaches"

        claimsIntakeService -> triageService "hands accepted claims to"
        triageService -> assessmentService "routes claims to"
        assessmentService -> payoutService "requests settlements from"

        claimsIntakeService -> fraudScreeningService "sends each incoming claim for fraud screening"
        claimsIntakeService -> policyVerificationService "sends each incoming claim for cover verification"
        claimsIntakeService -> assignmentService "sends each incoming claim for assignment"
        assignmentService -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims to"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads from"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes"
        notificationService -> policyholder "reports claim status changes"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "system-context" "Who uses the Claims Center and which external systems it talks to" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }

        container claimsCenter "front-office" "How policyholders report claims and track their progress" {
            include policyholder webPortal mobileAppBackend claimsIntakeService assessmentService payoutService documentService notificationService
            autoLayout
        }

        container claimsCenter "claims-processing" "How claims are triaged, assessed, screened, verified and assigned" {
            include claimsIntakeService triageService assessmentService payoutService fraudScreeningService policyVerificationService assignmentService adjusterWorkbench reinsuranceAllocationService nationalClaimsDataBureau
            autoLayout
        }

        container claimsCenter "data-and-batch" "The data stores and batch processing that support the platform" {
            include batchScheduler eventQueue claimsDatabase policyDatabase auditDatabase documentStore documentService
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}
